data.body: **[P1] Escape raw values that use the reserved envelope marker.** With no active offloader this returns the SerDes text unchanged, while operation deserialization treats every `@aws-durable-payload:` prefix as an SDK envelope. A valid custom/pass-through SerDes value such as `@aws-durable-payload:v2:{}` therefore fails during first-execution normalization and replay. Encode marker-prefixed raw text as an integrity-bound inline envelope even when external offloading is disabled, route operation serialization through that escaping path, and add first-execution/replay coverage with a custom SerDes.
